name: Xeramail
summary: Free temporary email: disposable inboxes that delete themselves after 24 hours, plus aliases and a developer API.
description: A disposable email service. Generate a random or custom address without signing up, pick a domain, and read incoming mail for up to 24 hours (up to 30 days on Pro) behind a secret key. A developer API creates inboxes and auto-extracts verification codes, and a built-in test email tool helps debug signup and email flows.
contains: free disposable inboxes deleted after 24 hours
Pro from $3/month: inboxes up to 30 days, attachments, forwarding aliases, no ads
random and custom addresses across multiple domains; 1 private custom domain on free
developer API (/api/v1) with inbox creation and OTP extraction
built-in test email tool for debugging delivery
no account required for basic use
